rules.name: Bundesfinanzgerichts Genitive
rules.description: Matches 'Bundesfinanzgerichts' (genitive form) which is often missed by the standard court rule. This is now redundant with the updated 'Specific Court Names' rule but kept for explicit priority if needed, or can be removed if the main rule covers it. Given the main rule now includes 'es|s', this specific rule is redundant and will be deleted.

rules.name: Amt für Betrugsbekämpfung
rules.description: Matches the specific anti-fraud authority 'Amt für Betrugsbekämpfung' in any case or with genitive endings, capturing the full entity name.

rules.name: Finanzamt für Großbetriebe

rules.name: Landesgericht with City
rules.description: Matches 'Landesgericht' or 'Landesgerichts' followed by a city name or identifier, capturing the full entity.

rules.name: Alpen-KI GmbH
rules.description: Matches specific company names like 'Alpen-KI GmbH' which were missed by generic patterns.

rules.name: Treuhand-Union Villach
rules.description: Matches specific company names like 'Treuhand-Union Villach Wirtschafts- treuhand- und Steuerberatungs GmbH'.

rules.name: ÖBB Acronym

rules.description: Matches specific court names including genitive forms and the '(BFG)' suffix. Fixed to capture 'Landesgerichts' followed by a city name.

rules.name: Wiener Gebietskrankenkasse
rules.description: Matches the specific organization 'Wiener Gebietskrankenkasse' which was missing from the rules.

rules.name: FB + KG Acronym
rules.description: Matches company names with '+' in the middle followed by 'KG', such as 'FB + KG', to capture the full entity.

rules.name: Magistrat der Stadt
rules.description: Matches 'Magistrat' or 'Magistrats' followed by 'der Stadt' and city name, explicitly excluding trailing department info like 'Magistratsabteilung'.

rules.name: BFG and VwGH Acronyms
rules.description: Matches full court names including '(BFG)' suffix as a single entity. Updated to capture 'Bundesfinanzgericht' followed by optional genitive endings and the '(BFG)' suffix as one unit, preventing split matches.

rules.name: Frontex Acronym
rules.description: Matches the 'Frontex' organization acronym which was missing from the rules.

rules.name: Bundesministerium für Finanzen

rules.description: Matches 'Wiener Gemeindebezirk' as an organization entity.

rules.name: GmbH Company Names
rules.description: Matches company names ending in 'GmbH' with any alphanumeric prefix, including multiple words, hyphens, and '&' symbols, ensuring the full name is captured.

rules.name: Rentenversicherung Bund
rules.description: Matches 'Rentenversicherung Bund' as a specific organization entity.

rules.name: Magistrat der Stadt Wien Full
rules.description: Matches 'Magistrat der Stadt Wien' including optional department info like 'Magistratsabteilung 67', ensuring full capture and preventing partial 'Stadt Wien' matches.

rules.name: Deutschen Rentenversicherung Bund
rules.description: Matches 'Deutschen Rentenversicherung Bund' to capture the full genitive form of the pension insurance organization.

rules.name: WGKK Acronym
rules.description: Matches the 'WGKK' acronym (Wiener Gebietskrankenkasse) as an organization.

rules.name: Bundesministerium für Inneres
rules.description: Matches the full name 'Bundesministerium für Inneres' as an organization.

rules.name: Mur Steinstein Specific
rules.description: Matches the specific entity 'Mur Steinstein' which was missed or incorrectly captured as part of a GmbH pattern. Ensures it captures the name even if followed by 'GmbH' in some contexts, but prioritizes the standalone name if that is the intended entity.

rules.name: Stadt Wien Partial
rules.description: Matches 'Stadt Wien' as an organization entity when it appears as a standalone reference or part of a larger context, ensuring it is captured even if not preceded by 'Magistrat'.

rules.name: Wirtschaftsuniversität Wien
rules.description: Matches the specific organization 'Wirtschaftsuniversität Wien' which was missing from the rules.

rules.name: Bezirksgericht City
rules.description: Matches 'Bezirksgericht' followed by a city name or identifier (e.g., 'Bezirksgericht O', 'Bezirksgericht Wien').

rules.name: AGL Specific Entity
rules.description: Matches the specific entity 'AGL Wirtschaftstreuhand und Steuerberatungs GmbH' which was previously missed or partially captured.

rules.name: Verlag Derkel GmbH Specific
rules.description: Matches the specific company name 'Verlag Derkel GmbH' which was frequently missed or partially captured.

rules.name: Verwiltal-Pharma GmbH Specific
rules.description: Matches the specific hyphenated company name 'Verwiltal-Pharma GmbH'.

rules.name: Central Liaison Office
rules.description: Matches the specific organization 'Central Liaison Office' which was missing from the rules.

rules.name: Europäische Gerichtshof
rules.description: Matches the specific organization 'Europäische Gerichtshof' which was missing from the rules.

rules.name: Steinchen und Pflügler Specific
rules.description: Matches the specific company name 'Steinchen und Pflügler Handel GmbH' which was frequently missed by the general GmbH pattern due to the 'und' connector.

rules.name: FA Code Entity
rules.description: Matches 'FA' followed by a valid Finanzamt location (city, district, or code) or a specific multi-word location combination. Strictly excludes common verbs/prepositions.

rules.name: AG Company Names
rules.description: Matches company names ending in 'AG' with a preceding proper noun or alphanumeric prefix, allowing hyphens, plus signs, and multi-word names.

rules.name: KG Company Names
rules.description: Matches company names ending in 'KG' or 'GmbH & Co KG'. Requires a specific proper noun prefix (at least one capitalized word) before the legal form to avoid matching generic terms.

rules.name: Finanzamt Full Entity
rules.description: Matches 'Finanzamt' or 'Finanzamtes' followed by specific known locations, codes, or multi-city combinations. Includes 'Österreich' and 'Spittal Villach' explicitly.

rules.name: Zollamt Entity
rules.description: Matches 'Zollamt' or 'Zollamtes' followed by optional location (e.g., 'Zollamt Linz Wels') or standalone, ensuring strict word boundaries.

rules.name: Finanzamt Standalone
rules.description: Matches 'Finanzamt' or 'Finanzamtes' as a standalone entity. Prioritized to catch cases where it appears without a specific location suffix.

rules.name: Finanzpolizei Entity
rules.description: Matches the specific organization 'Finanzpolizei' which was missing from the rules.

rules.name: Bundesfinanzgericht (BFG) Suffix
rules.description: Matches 'Bundesfinanzgericht' with optional genitive endings and the '(BFG)' suffix as a single entity, preventing split matches.

rules.name: BFG Acronym Standalone
rules.description: Matches the standalone acronym 'BFG' in legal contexts, ensuring it is captured as an organisation only when not part of a full name.

rules.name: Fa. Company Names
rules.description: Matches company names prefixed with 'Fa.' (Firma), handling the specific case of 'Fa.Brocke Robotik GmbH' and similar structures.

rules.name: Landesgerichtes with City
rules.description: Matches 'Landesgerichtes' or 'Landesgericht' followed by a city name or identifier, capturing the full court name and city.

rules.name: Specific GmbH Company Names
rules.description: Matches specific known company names that were missed by generic patterns, including 'Analyse Allexwald GmbH', 'Brocke Robotik GmbH', and 'c Stahl und Anlagenbau GmbH'.
rules.content: \b(?:Analyse Allexwald|Brocke Robotik|c Stahl und Anlagenbau) GmbH\b
